verses.text: <pb/><t>Le, i mara nma, eyìm, le, i mara nma;</t> <t>Anya-gi abua di ka nduru n'azu ákwà-nkpuchi-gi:</t> <t>Agiri-isi-gi di ka ìgwè ewu,</t> <t>Nke nēdina ala n'akuku ugwu Gilead.</t>
<t>Ezé-gi di ka ìgwè nne-aturu nke akpachaworo aji-ha ọhu,</t> <t>Nke siworo n'isa-aru rigota;</t> <t>Nke ha nile chi umu abua umu abua,</t> <t>Ọ dighi kwa nke b͕a aka nwa n'etiti ha.</t>
<t>Dika ogho uhie ka eb͕ub͕ere-ọnu-gi abua bu,</t> <t>Okwu-ọnu-gi ma-kwa-ra nma:</t> <t>Dika iberibe pomegranate ka akuku egedege-iru-gi bu</t> <t>N'azu ákwà-nkpuchi-gi.</t>
<t>Dika ulo-elu Devid, nke ewuru idebe ihe-agha, otú a ka olu-gi di,</t> <t>Nke ekobeworo nnù ọta abua na ọgu iri,</t> <t>Bú ọta ntà nile nke ndi-dike.</t>
<t>Ara-gi abua di ka umu-mb͕ada abua nke bu umu abua nke otù nne-mb͕ada muru,</t> <t>Nke nāta nri n'etiti urodi.</t>
<t>Rue mb͕e ifufe anyasi nēfe n'ubọchi, mb͕e onyinyo nile nāb͕alaga kwa,</t> <t>Mu onwem gēje n'ugwu myrrh,</t> <t>Na n'ugwu ntà frankincense.</t>
<t>I mazuru nma, eyìm;</t> <t>Ọ dighi kwa ntupọ di n'aru-gi. <pb/></t>

<t>Si na Lebanon som, nwunye ọhu nkem,</t> <t>Si na Lebanon som:</t> <t>Site n'elu Amana le anya,</t> <t>Site n'elu Senia na Heamon,</t> <t>Site n'ebe-obibi nile nke ọdum.</t> <t>Site n'ugwu nile nke agu.</t>
<t>I riwo obim, nwa-nnem nwayi;</t> <t>I werewo otù nime anya-gi abua,</t> <t>I werewo kwa otù ihe-inya-n'olu site n'olu-gi, rie obim.</t>

<t>Le ka ihu-n'anya-gi nile si ma nma nke-uku, nwa-nnem nwayi, nwunye ọhu nkem!</t> <t>Le ka ihu-n'anya-gi nile si di nma nke-uku kari manya-vine!</t> <t>Le kwa ka ísì utọ nke manu-gi nile di nma nke-uku kari uda nile!</t>

<t>Manu-aṅu nke si n'ub͕ub͕ọ-manu-aṅu abusi ka eb͕ub͕ere-ọnu-gi abua nābusi, nwunye ọhu nkem:</t> <t>Manu-aṅu na miri-ara-ehi di n'okpuru ire-gi;</t> <t>Ísì utọ nke uwe-gi nile di kwa ka ísì utọ Lebanon.</t>
<t>Ubi ab͕ara ogige nke akpachiri akpachi ka nwa-nnem nwayi, bú nwunye ọhu nkem, bu;</t> <t>Ebe-nsuputa-miri akpachiri akpachi, isi-iyi ab͕achiri ab͕achi.</t>
<t>Ome-gi nile bu ogige ọma nke pome-granate, nwere nkpuru di iche iche di oké ọnu-ahia;</t> <t>Henna, ya na osisi manu nard nile,</t>
<t>Manu nard na saffron,</t> <t>Calamus na cinnamon, ha na osisi nile nke frankincense;</t> <t>Myrrh na aloes, ha na isi uda nile.</t>
<t>Isi-iyi nke ubi nile ab͕ara ogige ka i bu,</t> <t>Olùlù-miri nke juputara na miri di ndu,</t> <t>Na miri-iyi di iche iche nke nērù erù site na Lebanon. <pb/></t>

<t>Teta, gi ifufe Ugwu; bia kwa, gi ifufe Ndida;</t> <t>Fekwasi ubim ab͕ara ogige, ka uda-ya di iche iche we rùpu.</t> <t>Ka onye ihe-ya nātọm utọ bata n'ubi-ya ab͕ara ogige,</t> <t>We rie nkpuru-ya di iche iche nke di oké ọnu-ahia.</t>
